entries.title: Linked data, full-width auto-sizing page, highlighter, bigger orb
bullets: Data is now linked — Loren no longer runs her own count. The embedded search page is the single source of truth for the number and the listings, so the reply and the page can't disagree (the old 4-vs-1,238 mismatch is gone).
No more scroll-within-scroll or tablet margins — the inline page auto-sizes to its full content and the conversation uses the full screen width. It never opens a separate page.
Loren can now highlight key text like a real Sharpie (yellow / green / red / orange) and render illuminated gradient links.
The orb is now larger than Loren's photo — her portrait sits inside the moving, glowing orb, consistent on every instance (header, composer, each message).
